bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money to Union Gospel Mission Twin Cities for workforce development services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; UNION GOSPEL MISSION TWIN CITIES. +]

[+$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Union Gospel Mission Twin Cities to continue to provide and improve adult education and workforce development services for adults facing homelessness, hunger, and addiction. These services include job-seeking skill development; education, including GED, ESL, job readiness, and financial literacy, as well as support services to remove barriers to employment including clothing, transportation, and child care. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money to Union Gospel Mission Twin Cities for workforce development services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; UNION GOSPEL MISSION TWIN CITIES.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Union Gospel Mission Twin Cities to continue to provide and improve adult education and workforce development services for adults facing homelessness, hunger, and addiction. These services include job-seeking skill development; education, including GED, ESL, job readiness, and financial literacy, as well as support services to remove barriers to employment including clothing, transportation, and child care. This is a onetime appropriation.

This is a onetime appropriation.
